mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p-value > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: Continuously rising nonfarm employment indicates robust labor market conditions that sustain consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns do not exceed 0.5% on average in months with PAYEMS growth > 0.5% (compared to baseline), or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment exceeds 5.5%, it signals deteriorating labor market health that reduces consumer confidence and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE > 5.5% (or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 2000 thousand units indicate contraction in residential construction, a key demand component, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with HOUST < 2000 (or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad consumer demand expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through joint sectoral momentum.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 2200 and RSAFS > 330000 does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances (or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) signals broad-based economic recovery that boosts corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO > 115 and GDPC1 > 11000 does not yield positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases (or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows).

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), rate hikes increase borrowing costs and reduce economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows).

mechanism_narrative: In tight labor markets (UNRATE < 4.5%), low unemployment supports sustained consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when UNRATE < 4.5% (or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows).
